card.name: Words setting up a span or limit
card.fires_on: Small words that open an amount, duration or limit, such as 'of' after 'a total', 'several' or 'one' before a time unit, and 'point' or 'so' before a stated limit. They are mostly in dosing and duration instructions.

modes.label: Duration lead-in
modes.description: A quantity word starting a stretch of time, right before days, weeks or minutes.
modes.example: may progress for<< several>> days before recovery begins.

modes.label: Total or limit phrase
modes.description: A linking word in a phrase about a total, point or extent reached.
modes.example: Repeat daily for a total<< of>> seven consecutive days.

card.plain: It fires on the little word that comes just before a number or length of time, like 'for a total of' or 'over several' days.
